_meta.source: MM2_RE_KIT/MM2_PSEUDOCODE/<Class>/<Class>.c, every source function verified by address against data/symbols.json (the retail linker map)
_meta.schema: data/layouts.json plus per-class confidence/evidence/corroboration and a per-member evidence kind and source function
_meta.WARNING: 'size_lower_bound' is a FLOOR, never a size. Only 'size' (present when MM2Hook corroborates) may be fed to check_size(). Pinning a struct too small is a silent corruption.

evidence_kinds.datParser: datParser::AddRecord/AddValue - offset, width and the 1999 field NAME
evidence_kinds.format: a printf-style call inside a Dump/Print/Debug method - offset, width, NAME
evidence_kinds.format-weak: a printf-style call somewhere else - the label may be prose
evidence_kinds.subobject: Base::FileIO(this + N, ...) - a sub-object of a known class at N
evidence_kinds.stream: Stream::Read/Write(s, this + N, LEN) - offset and exact width, no name
evidence_kinds.memset: memset(this + N, 0, LEN) - a block's extent only
evidence_kinds.memcpy: memcpy/qmemcpy touching this + N - a copied block's extent only
